# Hyphening Media

> Hyphening Media is a creative operations and marketing agency that scales D2C, B2B, F&B, and healthcare brands through data-driven content strategy, video production, social media operations, and full-stack web and app development.

Hyphening Media scripts, shoots, produces and measures the work itself, so a campaign and its numbers sit under one roof. Reports lead with click-through rate, conversions and organic reach rather than vanity metrics. For clinics and dental practices, content is educational only: no testimonials, no before-and-after images, no outcome promises and no superlatives, and every claim is tied to a source.

Based in Bengaluru, India. Led by Joseph George (CEO) and Deepanjan Sarkar (COO).

## Capabilities

- [Content Strategy](https://hypheningmedia.com/capabilities/content-strategy): monthly plans with scripts, hooks and posting schedules
- [Video Production](https://hypheningmedia.com/capabilities/video-production): short-form and long-form video from script to final edit
- [Social Media Ops](https://hypheningmedia.com/capabilities/social-media-ops): daily management across Instagram, YouTube and LinkedIn
- [Web Development](https://hypheningmedia.com/capabilities/web-development): custom websites and web apps
- [App Development](https://hypheningmedia.com/capabilities/app-development): mobile apps
- [Performance Analytics](https://hypheningmedia.com/capabilities/performance-analytics): a secure client portal with near real-time, platform-level performance
- [Campaign Management](https://hypheningmedia.com/capabilities/campaign-management): organic and paid campaigns measured against enquiries, bookings and cost per acquisition
- [Brand Development](https://hypheningmedia.com/capabilities/brand-development): visual identity systems, positioning and tone-of-voice guides
- [News Media Coverage & PR](https://hypheningmedia.com/capabilities/news-media-pr): news-media placements that build authority
